description: An ahead task implied only by the ingredient line (rice cooked and chilled overnight), mise written mid-cook after the eggs, and peas used straight from the freezer (not mise). No hands-off time.

steps: Break up any clumps in the cold rice with your fingers.
Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a wok over high heat, scramble the eggs until just set, and tip them onto a plate.
Dice the carrot and the char siu, and thinly slice the green onions, keeping the whites and greens apart.
Add the remaining oil to the wok, then the carrot and the green onion whites, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the garlic and char siu and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and press it against the wok, tossing, for 3 minutes, until hot and starting to crisp.
Add the peas straight from the freezer and toss for 1 minute.
Season with the soy sauce, sesame oil, and white pepper, fold the eggs back in, and scatter over the green onion greens.
